description: A scripted tour with a French family, a German visitor and a guest who uses blink input. Played through the same path as live speech (minus Whisper), so the demo works in a noisy hall.

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: Welcome to our farm. My family has worked this land for four generations.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: Merci, c'est magnifique ici. Le thé est délicieux, qu'est-ce que c'est ?

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: It's sage tea, from herbs we grow right here on the farm.

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: These are our olive trees. Some of them are very old.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: Quel âge ont les plus vieux arbres ?

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: We have about 600 trees, and the oldest are thought to be over 300 years old.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: Wann ist die Ernte? Kann man dabei mithelfen?

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: Yes, from mid-October to December our Saturday tours include picking olives.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: Est-ce que vous arrosez les arbres ?

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: No, the trees are rain-fed. We never irrigate.

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: This is our stone press. We still use it for small batches.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: Combien d'olives faut-il pour un litre d'huile ?

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: About five kilos of olives make one litre of oil.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: Ist das Öl biologisch?

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: I'm not sure how to answer that, I'll check.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: Can I taste it?

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: Of course, here's some fresh bread to dip in the oil.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: C'est incroyable, je l'adore. Est-ce qu'on peut en acheter ?

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: Yes, the 500 ml bottle is 8 JOD and the litre is 14 JOD.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: Vous pouvez l'envoyer en France ?

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: I'm sorry, I don't know if we can ship. I'll find out.

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: This is the herb garden: za'atar, sage, mint and chamomile.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: Es ist sehr heiß heute, ich bin etwas müde.

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: Let's rest in the shade for a moment and have some water.

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: Lunch today is maqluba, cooked by my mother.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: Ma fille est végétarienne, c'est possible ?

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: Yes, we can make a vegetarian plate for her.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: I would like to come back again.

steps.speaker: guide
steps.text: We'd love that. The harvest Saturdays are a wonderful time to come back.

steps.speaker: guest
steps.text: Comment est-ce qu'on réserve pour la récolte avec des amis ?
